name: Wild oat
desc: A wild annual grass of the Mediterranean and steppe zones that sprouts after winter rain and feeds grazers and seed eaters.
about: Avena sterilis (animated oat, sterile oat, wild oat, wild red oat, winter wild oat; syn. Avena ludoviciana Durieu; Avena macrocarpa Moench; Avena sterilis ssp.
